description: Semantic + keyword search over Visdenda's own documentation (API manual, scopes, quotas, agent flow, fix loop). Use when a tool result is unclear or an error needs explaining, before asking a human. Returns up to 8 doc excerpts with source URLs and relevance scores; fetch a source URL with Accept: text/markdown for the full page. Read-only; no external network request. Fails closed (tool-error) when the search index is unavailable.
name: visdenda_search_docs
title: Search Visdenda docs
